design: Refundable 1,000-SOS deposits backed by single-use wallet-bound receipts. Each receipt has a seven-day withdrawal lock. Principal pool controlled by the project authority.

approval.note: Initial deployment is live. A sale/withdrawal rule repair is awaiting owner approval; the page checks the actual records and enables buying only after both updates land.

warnings: W-FEE: 0.002 SOL platform fee for each purchase, 20% above the 0.01 SOL sticker price.
Deposits and withdrawals each also pay a 0.002 SOL platform fee.
Project authority can spend deposited principal, alter receipts or pause withdrawals. Operator trust required.
